prompt.project_info: Create a high-contrast luxury street-style fashion editorial in a monochrome orange studio.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional male model with original non-celebrity features, wearing a tailored bright-orange suit, white shirt, and orange tie. He leans against a sharp architectural corner with a composed fashion-editorial attitude.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle 24mm perspective, oversized orange-and-black sneakers dominating the foreground through forced perspective, a generic vintage orange hatchback parked in the background, clean geometric studio lines, seated or leaning pose.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directional lighting with strong graphic shadows, saturated monochrome orange environment, crisp luxury street-style atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-detail editorial photography, 4:5 aspect ratio, 24mm low-angle lens perspective, sharp subject and footwear detail, realistic materials and proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-contrast low-angle 24mm fashion editorial photograph of an adult fictional male model in a tailored bright-orange suit, white shirt, and orange tie, leaning against a sharp corner in a monochrome orange studio with clean geometric lines. Oversized orange-and-black sneakers dominate the foreground in forced perspective. A generic vintage orange hatchback is parked in the background. Dramatic lighting with strong shadows, luxury street-style aesthetic, 4:5 aspect ratio.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, named fictional character, recognizable brand logo, trademark text, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, warped car, watermark, signature, illegible text

assets.name: high-contrast-orange-studio-editorial.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the orange monochrome studio, tailored suit, low-angle framing, oversized foreground sneakers, and vintage hatchback while replacing the named character and branded details with generic equivalents.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the orange palette, composition, pose, footwear scale, vehicle placement, and lighting consistency. Use an original adult fictional model; replace the named character, vehicle brand, and shoe logos with generic replaceable products. Keep outfit, environment, logo, and typography details clean and brand-neutral.

changes: Replaced the named character, vehicle example, and branded sneaker reference with an original adult fictional model and generic products.
